history.summary: ShobieShy approved 'Yes, switch to Godot' (via Tex). C++20/Vulkan engine archived (branch archive/cpp-vulkan-engine at d07497b; files git-mv'd to archive/cpp-engine/, old plan/state in archive/cpp-engine/docs/). Old plan had steps 1-23 done of 56. New Godot plan: step 1 = Godot 4.7.2 project setup + headless test runner; steps 3-12 port the finished gameplay.
history.plan_changes: BUILD_PLAN rewritten for Godot (merged UI renderer into HUD, audio engine+hookup, save format+load; removed cooker/CMake/Vulkan steps). ADR-0002 added; PLAN §23-25,27 engine parts updated.

history.summary: Midden greybox ported: tools/toml_to_scene.py (stdlib tomllib, C++ loader's validation, --check/--self-test in run_tests.sh) generates scenes/levels/midden.tscn from data/levels/midden_greybox.toml: 17 StaticBody3D boxes (1 ground, 5 wall, 1 platform, 2 ramp, 3 heap, 5 crate) with BoxMesh/BoxShape3D sizes, Y-X-Z rotations, linear->sRGB palette, exp fog 0.006, sun, PlayerStart (0,0,12.5) facing north + Eye 1.5 m, EnemySpawns. scripts/world/level_toml.gd reads the TOML in GDScript; test_level.gd 9 tests (400/400 down-rays up-facing). main.tscn instances the Midden. ci.yml extended (setup-python, cached Godot 4.7.2, import, run_tests.sh); not pushed. run_tests.sh green: 14 unit tests, 2 s smoke 120 ticks, asset lint OK.
history.plan_changes: Bug fixes from step 1: test runner moved from _initialize to first physics frame (physics queries need the root in its World3D); timeouts on every Godot call in run_tests.sh; main.tscn placeholder ground replaced by the Midden. Refined steps 3 (spawn at PlayerStart/Eye), 11 (dummies from EnemySpawns), 12 (NavigationRegion3D emitted by generator, like Magewar landfill), 14 (waves as TOML table), 41 (judge palette: TOML linear vs Magewar sRGB).

history.summary: FPS controller ported: Player CharacterBody3D (scenes/player/player.tscn, scripts/player/player.gd; feet origin, layer 'character') with PlayerTuning resource and PlayerInput: walk 4 / crouch 3 m/s, LERP 10 / AIR 6, jump 4.5/3.0 on press edge, gravity 9.8, capsule 0.3x1.7/0.7, eye 1.5/0.6, Cogito-style 0.35 m step climbing, floor_max_angle 45, snap 0.5, 0.25 deg/count look, pitch +-89. InputMap in project.godot (Magewar action names + dash, slot_1-4; crouch C+LCtrl). main.tscn spawns the player at PlayerStart (camera = PlayerStart/Eye), placeholder camera removed. run_tests.sh green: 24 unit tests (10 new in test_player.gd: walk 3.667 m, apex 1.072/0.485 m, crouch eye 0.6 under 1 m slab, 0.35 step climbed / 0.5 blocked, ramp_west -> ledge y 1.500), 2 s smoke 120 ticks, asset lint OK.
history.plan_changes: Bug fix from step 2: test runner now runs on the 2nd physics frame (get_physics_process_delta_time() is 0 on the 1st, so move_and_slide didn't move). Magewar check: action names aligned with Magewar; pitch +-89 kept vs Magewar +-90. Refined steps 4 (Player.tick hooks), 5 (head smoothing over steps, Cogito step_height_camera_lerp), 10 (mouse wheel = Magewar quickslot_prev/next_wieldable), 30 (inventory action on Tab), 32 (rebind over project.godot InputMap), 39 (menu action on Esc).

history.summary: Sprint, Breath and slide ported: scripts/player/breath.gd (Breath RefCounted: 100 max, drain 20/s, regen 30/s after 1 s with sub-tick timing, exhausted until 20, spend/set_max_bonus/refill), PlayerTuning sprint 7 / slide 5 m/s, 1.5 s, slide jump x1.3 + Breath numbers (PLAN 30.8), Player.tick sprint (ground start, move key, not crouched/exhausted, kept in air, drains), Magewar slide from sprint+Crouch along the entry direction at (t/1.5+0.5) x 5 m/s, slide jump keeps its speed, set_speed_multiplier (walk/sprint/crouch). main.gd prints a [player] exit line. run_tests.sh green: 35 unit tests (6 new test_breath: empty 300, resume 100, full 260, 60/144 Hz; 5 new test_player: sprint 7.000 m/s, dry 300 / resume 101, x1.1 4.4/7.7/3.3, slide 89 ticks 7.542 m, no slide from walk/standing/exhausted, slide jump apex 1.795 m), 2 s smoke 120 ticks, asset lint OK.
history.plan_changes: Magewar check: sprint/slide numbers match Cogito's tscn overrides; Breath numbers kept from PLAN 30.8 over Cogito stamina (30/3/2 after 2 s, jump cost 5); resume_at 20 deviation kept; speed_modifier scales crouch too like Magewar; CAN_BUNNYHOP not ported. No bugs found in steps 1-3.

history.summary: Dash + camera feel ported: scripts/player/dash.gd (Dash RefCounted: 6 m in 0.15 s at 40 m/s, 2 charges recharging one at a time every 1.5 s, 25 Breath via breath.spend, 0.1 s i-frames, one air dash per jump, set_bonus_charges), scripts/player/camera_feel.gd (CameraFeel: Cogito wiggle bob walk 0.03/12, sprint 0.05/16, crouch 0.08/8 centred, landing dip 0.12 m x clamp((v-2)/6), step-up smoothing at 2.5/s, reduced motion zeroes bob+dip, bob scale). Player: dash on press edge along move keys or look, ends slide, blocks slides, walls stop it; landings/last_landing_speed; Head = eye + feel offset; camera_position/camera_offset/dashing/invulnerable/set_reduced_motion. PlayerTuning Dash + Camera feel groups. run_tests.sh green: 50 unit tests (9 new test_dash: 6.0000 m in 9 ticks, 3rd refused, recharge 90/180, i-frames 6/15 ticks at 60/144 Hz, wall stop at -2.700, one air dash, Breath refusal, dash out of slide; 6 new test_camera_feel: bob amplitudes, dip 0.06/0.12, reduced motion 0, step up eased <=0.015 m/tick), 2 s smoke 120 ticks, asset lint OK.

history.summary: Elements + damage formula ported: scripts/combat/element_table.gd (ElementTable Resource: Element enum in Magewar order, ARCANE = Magewar NONE; strong 1.5 / weak 0.5; Array[ElementDef] rows; effectiveness() with same/Arcane x1.0 in code and a cached 7x7 chart from the data; rebuild(); validate() with the C++ loader's checks; load_default()), scripts/combat/element_def.gd, resources/magic/elements.tres (Magewar names/colours, Fire>Earth>Air>Water>Fire, Light<->Dark), scripts/combat/damage.gd (Damage: wieldable_damage = base x rarity + sum part bonuses; resolve_hit x effectiveness x (1 - resist capped 0.6) x weak point 2; Target/Result with strong()/weak()). run_tests.sh green: 61 unit tests (11 new test_damage: 49/49 = Magewar get_effectiveness, 6 strong / 4 weak, names/colours = Magewar + PLAN hex, .tres = data/magic/elements.toml, 14 bad tables rejected, patch rebuild, rarity x1.0-x3.0 + part bonuses, resist 0.8/0.9 -> 0.6, weak point x2, Fire vs Earth 15, worked example 25.2000 and 7.2), 2 s smoke 120 ticks, asset lint OK.
